question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate as lower_bound,
        avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate as upper_bound
    FROM stats
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(s.avg_loss_rate), 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(s.stddev_loss_rate), 2) as stddev_loss_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < t.lower_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as below_std,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > t.upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as above_std,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v."loss_rate_%" >= t.lower_bound AND v."loss_rate_%" <= t.upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as within_std
FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, thresholds t, stats s
